title: A rowdy dance, the jail and Buddy Petit's band
summary: Story of a dance that ended in a fight and lost watch, arrests held at a west end jail, and Buddy Petit leading the band.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs
